summary: Helsinki, Finland, graphics artist, former film editor, experience in mobile game development, strong interest in open-source software, advocate for user-friendly technology, critical of corporate monopolies, engaged in discussions about software development practices, familiarity with programming languages (C, C++, Objective-C), experience with mobile operating systems (Symbian, Maemo, MeeGo), interest in HTML5 and web technologies, active in tech communities, has worked on software tools for artists, has a background in the demoscene, critical of proprietary software ecosystems, values user privacy and open standards.
